name: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd
title: Stanley Lifestyles Ltd - 544202 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Stanley is a COCO-led furniture retailer with flat revenue since FY23, Q4 B2B pulled down by ~Rs 15 crore, and only a qualitative FY27 "double-digit aspiration"; supply discipline is weak as stores keep expanding.

utilisation.quote: Our cash reserve remains strong at almost Rs. 200 crores as of end of this year as compared to last year where we ended with Rs. 215 crores.

capex.quote: In spite of our highest ever capital investment exceeding Rs. 60 crores, this clearly reflects disciplined capital allocation

triggers.label: B2B pulled down ~Rs 15 crore in Q4
triggers.quote: there was a small pull-down from our B2B business of almost about Rs. 15 crores.

triggers.label: Highest ever capex >Rs 60 crore
triggers.quote: In spite of our highest ever capital investment exceeding Rs. 60 crores

triggers.label: Franchisee business down 35%
triggers.quote: there is a 35% drop in our franchisee business.

triggers.label: Same-store sales ~4% over three years
triggers.quote: Most of the stores which are over three years have grown by about 4%.

triggers.label: FY27 growth 'aspirational' double-digit, no number
triggers.quote: While we are quite aspirational to deliver definitely double-digit growth

guidance.quote: While we are quite aspirational to deliver definitely double-digit growth
today if you ask me in 2026, I will safely say that our ROI is about 3 years.

red_flags.label: Revenue flat since FY23 despite store doubling
red_flags.quote: if we look at the revenue since FY23, we have seen no growth and EBITDA margins have been falling.

red_flags.label: Same-store sales ~4% vs 10-15% target
red_flags.quote: we expect a healthy matured stores to generate about 10% to 15% going forward.

red_flags.label: Operating profit barely covers interest and depreciation
red_flags.quote: The operating profit that we made this year barely covers our interest payments and the depreciation.

red_flags.label: Flagship launch delayed; revenue deferred
red_flags.quote: resulting in a deferment of revenue recognition by a couple of quarters.

evasions.topic: Revenue growth drivers vs flat revenue
evasions.quote: Not in terms of top line, but also in terms of bottom and top line both.
Actually, there is not a dip in our margin.
we have a slightly different method of looking at our business.
